sections.heading: 1. Tight-seat set-up
lines: ① Rest the laptop on your bag or a pillow.
② Elbows on the armrests, shoulders relaxed.
③ Every 20 min, look up and do 5 chin tucks.
④ On a flight, stand and walk every 1–2 hours.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…
lines: arm or hand tingles — stop and get advice.

caption:
Mr Turtle works on the plane, laptop on his knees. By landing, his neck already feels stiff.

Laptops join the screen and keyboard, so on your knees your head tips a long way down. Even in a tight seat, raising the laptop on your bag and looking up often can help.

Hybi's 1-minute set-up: elbows on the armrests, look up and do 5 chin tucks every 20 minutes, and on a flight stand and walk every 1–2 hours. Stop if your arm tingles.

Headaches, arm tingling, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
